name: Human Digestive System (Gastrointestinal Tract & Accessory Organs)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade 3D model of the human digestive system with dual presentation collections (Digestive_Full and Digestive_Section). Features mouth, salivary glands, esophagus, J-shaped muscular stomach with coronal section revealing internal gastric rugae, dual-lobed liver, gallbladder with cystic and common bile ducts, lobulated pancreas with pancreatic duct entering at the hepatopancreatic ampulla (Ampulla of Vater), duodenal C-loop, coiled small intestine, and framed large intestine with caecum, vermiform appendix, haustrated colon, rectum, and anus. Aligned with CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.6 and CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 16 Figures 16.1-16.3.
simplifications: Intestinal coils modeled as continuous serpentine loops for pedagogical clarity while maintaining complete lumen continuity.
Section collection provides clean coronal cutaway of stomach displaying gastric rugae folds and internal wall thickness.
